c.intro: Shares CrowdSec bans between your NethServer 8 hosts and other servers through one private hub. Nothing is sent to the CrowdSec cloud.
c.aboutSources: Failed logins are detected from SSH, the NS8 admin login, Gitea and Organizr (through the Traefik access log) and Samba (JSON authentication audit). Any member's detection bans the address on every member.
c.aboutCloud: The CrowdSec Central API, community blocklist and console enrollment are always disabled.
c.timeout: The task did not finish in time
c.roleHelp: Install the companion on every host. One instance is the hub: it stores the shared ban list and receives the detections of all members. The others connect to it as members.
c.roleFixed: The role cannot be changed after setup. Install a new instance to change it.
c.hubHost: Public host name of the hub
c.hubHostHelp: Point this DNS name to this node. Members connect to https://<host>/; NS8 Traefik provides HTTPS.
c.tokenHelp: Create the token on the hub under Members and paste it here.
c.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current connection.
c.insecure: Accept an untrusted hub certificate (testing only)
c.banDurationHelp: Minutes or hours, for example 30m or 4h. Applied by the hub to every new ban.
c.allowlistHelp: Addresses and networks that are never banned on any member, one per line. Private networks are allowlisted automatically.
c.allowlistMember: The allowlist is managed on the hub.
c.sambaAuditHelp: Raises Samba's JSON authentication audit level in the running Samba process of this node. The saved Samba configuration is not changed.
c.membersHelp: Each member uses its own credentials. Remove a member to revoke its access.
c.hubOnly: This page is available on the hub only.
c.memberNameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, for example the host name.
c.tokenOnceHelp: It is shown only once. Paste it into the member's settings.
c.manualSetup: For a server without NS8, put these values into the CrowdSec agent and firewall bouncer configuration:
c.name: Name
c.confirmRemove: Remove member {name}? Its agent and firewall bouncer lose access to the hub.
c.bansHelp: Bans active on all members. Unbanning here removes the address from every member's firewall within seconds.
c.notConfigured: The module is not configured yet.

err.invalid_duration: Use minutes or hours, for example 30m or 4h
err.invalid_address: Enter IP addresses or networks only
err.invalid_member_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes
err.member_exists: A member with this name already exists
